subject: RE: Procurement kickoff & vendor acceptance prerequisites for Solvex
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@solvex.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@solvex.com
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement kickoff - vendor acceptance prerequisites

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our procurement team needs to confirm a few security and compliance items before we can proceed to contract and PO issuance for the pilot. Can you please provide the following artifacts and a short timeline for delivery?

1) SOC 2 Type II report (summary or bridge letter if full report redacted)
2) ISO 27001 attestation or statement of applicability
3) Recent penetration test attestation or executive summary (dated within last 18 months)
4) Standard vendor onboarding form (we've linked it below)
5) Point of contact for invoicing / PO and your legal counsel for contract redlines

Attachments: procurement onboarding checklist (we expect the vendor to return it completed).

We're aiming to have procurement sign-off by May 20 to align with our quarter planning. Let me know if you need more time.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
Solvex HealthTech
procurement@solvex.com

-----Original Message Follows-----

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@solvex.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement kickoff - vendor acceptance prerequisites

Hi Elena — thanks for outlining this. We're ready to assemble the package. Quick notes and owners from our side:

- SOC 2 Type II summary: Laura will send the cover letter and control summary. (ETA: 2 business days)
- ISO 27001 attestation: Marissa will attach the attestation PDF and mapping. (ETA: 3 business days)
- Pen test attestation: We have a pen test letter we can share; will confirm redaction policy. (ETA: 2 business days)
- Onboarding form: we'll complete the Solvex form and return it via your portal link.
- PO / invoicing: Finance contact is finance@redwood.ai; legal contact for contract redlines is legal@redwood.ai.

I'll bundle the artifacts and send a single package with a short cover email. If you need signed attestations or an SPI (security point of information) call, we can schedule one this week.

Karthik Iy er
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
